record.field: SO Line Product Not Available for Backorder
This rule triggers when a product on a sale order line is out of stock, is not a make-to-order (MTO) product, and does not allow backordering.
SO Line BoM Component Not Available for Backorder
This rule triggers when a component in a Bill of Materials (BoM) for a product on a sale order line is out of stock and does not allow backordering.
